programme.title: 絲路時間U Silk : 大漠胡楊
太平年
programme.desc: 太平年是一部2026年中國播出的歷史題材電視劇，該劇不以愛情線為主軸，但卻衝出了高收視高口碑！劇本紮實，拍攝水準好，許多場面都拍出磅礡大氣太平年由楊磊擔任總導演，董哲編劇，白宇周雨彤朱亞文俞灝明董勇倪大紅朱嘉琦等主演該劇以五代十國末期至北宋初年為時代背景，聚焦於吳越國納土歸宋的歷史事件，講述了吳越國王錢弘俶周世宗柴榮宋太祖趙匡胤宋太宗趙匡義等歷史人物擺脫戰火國殤，在亂世中尋求國家統一故事ampampampampampltbrampampampampampgt五代十國時期，錢弘俶（白宇 飾）趙匡胤（朱亞文 飾）郭榮（俞灝明 飾）三位有志青年經歷了家國動亂秩序崩潰生靈塗炭後，逐漸認識到只有國家一統才能擺脫戰火國殤錢弘俶於政權動亂之時扛起吳越國主的重任，保境安民，福澤一方；歷經戰亂的趙匡胤則延續了郭榮未竟的事業，建立北宋政權，嚴明軍紀，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一掃五代喪亂之頹風，向著天下太平一步步邁進最終，在北宋統一的大勢和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吳越王錢弘俶封疆獻土，納土歸宋，完成了中國歷史上一次偉大的統一本劇表達了中華民族自古以來對和平的熱切追求對統一大勢眾望所歸和對安定生活的真誠嚮往

programme.title: 大國建造第三季共同的建造
太平年
programme.desc: 太平年是一部2026年中國播出的歷史題材電視劇，該劇不以愛情線為主軸，但卻衝出了高收視高口碑！劇本紮實，拍攝水準好，許多場面都拍出磅礡大氣太平年由楊磊擔任總導演，董哲編劇，白宇周雨彤朱亞文俞灝明董勇倪大紅朱嘉琦等主演該劇以五代十國末期至北宋初年為時代背景，聚焦於吳越國納土歸宋的歷史事件，講述了吳越國王錢弘俶周世宗柴榮宋太祖趙匡胤宋太宗趙匡義等歷史人物擺脫戰火國殤，在亂世中尋求國家統一故事ampampampampltbrampampampampgt五代十國時期，錢弘俶（白宇 飾）趙匡胤（朱亞文 飾）郭榮（俞灝明 飾）三位有志青年經歷了家國動亂秩序崩潰生靈塗炭後，逐漸認識到只有國家一統才能擺脫戰火國殤錢弘俶於政權動亂之時扛起吳越國主的重任，保境安民，福澤一方；歷經戰亂的趙匡胤則延續了郭榮未竟的事業，建立北宋政權，嚴明軍紀，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一掃五代喪亂之頹風，向著天下太平一步步邁進最終，在北宋統一的大勢和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吳越王錢弘俶封疆獻土，納土歸宋，完成了中國歷史上一次偉大的統一本劇表達了中華民族自古以來對和平的熱切追求對統一大勢眾望所歸和對安定生活的真誠嚮往

programme.title: 口述澳門歷史名人堂
programme.desc: 作為中西方文化交匯的地方，澳門具有深厚的文化底蘊，這片純樸的土地，彌漫着攝人的靈氣，讓不少歷史名人在這裡留下了足跡，口述澳門歷史名人堂將介紹一系列曾在澳門生活，並有卓越貢獻之人士，例如賈梅士利瑪竇錢納利馬禮遜高劍父冼星海等節目將請來學者及各界嘉賓述說他們的故事，記錄這些名留千古的動人事跡，讓更多人認識他們！

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 商道
programme.desc: 19世紀紅頂商人林尚沃的發跡傳奇，大長今團隊經典之作原本立志成為譯官的林尚沃，卻因一場冤案家破人亡，淪為官奴他毅然投身商道，從基層夥計一步步崛起，憑藉過人的智慧誠信與膽識，在商戰中屢破困局，與宿敵鄭治壽展開跨越半生的競爭，也與命運多舛的多寧譜出刻骨銘心的愛情尚沃始終堅守以義取利的信念，更以商業改善民生造福百姓，最終成為朝鮮第一商人，譜寫出商海不朽傳奇

programme.title: 廉石傳奇
programme.desc: 講述了東吳陸績在廣西鬱林任職期間，改革落後生產提倡科教文化為官剛直不阿肅貪拒賄兩袖清風倡導廉政的故事陸績的清廉自守，深得鬱林百姓的擁戴，當鬱林城大兵壓境的危急關頭，全城數萬百姓挺身而出，都站在了太守的身後，一場懸殊的奪城之戰，卻因為太守的一呼百應和百姓們的眾志成城而大獲全勝

programme.title: 江海潮生
programme.desc: 清末民初列強入侵的動盪時代，末代狀元救國興邦的一生理想甲午戰敗，山河飄搖，國運浮沉 亂世之中，何以救亡圖存？ 看末代狀元張謇，棄官從商，實業救國， 在時代變局之中，以一生探索民族自強之道

programme.title: 九州縹緲錄
programme.desc: 青銅之血．星火燎原．斬鐵既出．天下歸宗媲美魔戒及冰與火之歌的東方奇幻大作九州大陸，群雄並立，各方勢力為了各自的信仰和野心殺伐爭鬥渾沌之中，黑暗力量蠢蠢欲動，世人呼喚英雄少年呂歸塵羽然姬野冥冥之中被推上亂世的舞台中心，攜手共戰，誓言開創自己的道路，與天下對抗，與命運爭鬥從迷茫到堅定，從單純到世故，不斷辯證理想與正義，慘綠少年，終成一代領袖

programme.title: 天下長河
programme.desc: 以康熙朝治水作為主自康熙十五年一場巨大的水患之後，年輕的康熙帝設科開舉招納治河賢才，二十四歲的落第舉子陳潢脱穎而出，長於治河年輕的康熙帝不拘一格，將他簡拔而出陳潢與同樣有志於治河的靳輔搭檔，跨越半個世紀的櫛風沐雨，歷經了康熙朝幾次大政治風波年輕敢言的陳潢死於奸臣結黨的污衊之下，臨死前留下治河的著作河防述要康熙五十一年，台灣收復，準噶爾平定，黃河安瀾，河水轉清康熙帝探訪揚州，見到了河神廟廟中塑着靳輔陳潢的雕像，仁人志士，遺愛自在民間

programme.desc: 19世紀紅頂商人林尚沃的發跡傳奇，大長今團隊經典之作原本立志成為譯官的林尚沃，卻因一場冤案家破人亡，淪為官奴他毅然投身商道，從基層夥計一步步崛起，憑藉過人的智慧誠信與膽識，在商戰中屢破困局，與宿敵鄭治壽展開跨越半生的競爭，也與命運多舛的多寧譜出刻骨銘心的愛情尚沃始終堅守以義取利的信念，更以商業改善民生造福百姓，最終成為朝鮮第一商人，譜寫出商海不朽傳奇

programme.title: 廉石傳奇
programme.desc: 講述了東吳陸績在廣西鬱林任職期間，改革落後生產提倡科教文化為官剛直不阿肅貪拒賄兩袖清風倡導廉政的故事陸績的清廉自守，深得鬱林百姓的擁戴，當鬱林城大兵壓境的危急關頭，全城數萬百姓挺身而出，都站在了太守的身後，一場懸殊的奪城之戰，卻因為太守的一呼百應和百姓們的眾志成城而大獲全勝

programme.title: 江海潮生
programme.desc: 清末民初列強入侵的動盪時代，末代狀元救國興邦的一生理想甲午戰敗，山河飄搖，國運浮沉 亂世之中，何以救亡圖存？ 看末代狀元張謇，棄官從商，實業救國， 在時代變局之中，以一生探索民族自強之道

programme.title: 九州縹緲錄
programme.desc: 青銅之血．星火燎原．斬鐵既出．天下歸宗媲美魔戒及冰與火之歌的東方奇幻大作九州大陸，群雄並立，各方勢力為了各自的信仰和野心殺伐爭鬥渾沌之中，黑暗力量蠢蠢欲動，世人呼喚英雄少年呂歸塵羽然姬野冥冥之中被推上亂世的舞台中心，攜手共戰，誓言開創自己的道路，與天下對抗，與命運爭鬥從迷茫到堅定，從單純到世故，不斷辯證理想與正義，慘綠少年，終成一代領袖

programme.title: 商道
programme.desc: 19世紀紅頂商人林尚沃的發跡傳奇，大長今團隊經典之作原本立志成為譯官的林尚沃，卻因一場冤案家破人亡，淪為官奴他毅然投身商道，從基層夥計一步步崛起，憑藉過人的智慧誠信與膽識，在商戰中屢破困局，與宿敵鄭治壽展開跨越半生的競爭，也與命運多舛的多寧譜出刻骨銘心的愛情尚沃始終堅守以義取利的信念，更以商業改善民生造福百姓，最終成為朝鮮第一商人，譜寫出商海不朽傳奇

programme.title: 天下長河
programme.desc: 以康熙朝治水作為主自康熙十五年一場巨大的水患之後，年輕的康熙帝設科開舉招納治河賢才，二十四歲的落第舉子陳潢脱穎而出，長於治河年輕的康熙帝不拘一格，將他簡拔而出陳潢與同樣有志於治河的靳輔搭檔，跨越半個世紀的櫛風沐雨，歷經了康熙朝幾次大政治風波年輕敢言的陳潢死於奸臣結黨的污衊之下，臨死前留下治河的著作河防述要康熙五十一年，台灣收復，準噶爾平定，黃河安瀾，河水轉清康熙帝探訪揚州，見到了河神廟廟中塑着靳輔陳潢的雕像，仁人志士，遺愛自在民間

programme.title: 吾王長存首
programme.desc: 吾王長存首

programme.title: 家有囍事
programme.desc: 常家三兄弟與父母同住在祖產大屋中老大常滿外遇情婦Sheila致其妻程氏離家出走老二常騷為一偏向女性化之男子，與偏向男性化之表姑媽梁無雙水火不容老三常歡為電台DJ兼花花公子，與影癡聽眾何里玉發展出戲劇化戀情三對歡喜冤家一路鬧出了不少笑話，最後大團圓結局收場

programme.title: A計劃續集
programme.desc: 開埠初期的香港之上環中環西環由有鎮三環之稱的鄭幫辦管制，鎮三環暗中勾結西環惡霸歐心虎，令治安一時烏煙瘴氣警官馬如龍奉命接管西環後速將歐心虎拘捕入獄，因而招致鎮三環的怨恨當時中國革命風雲翻湧，革命黨人來港宣傳並計劃營救被捕同志為將革命黨人一網打盡，清廷派遣密使聯絡鎮三環，馬如龍與結識的一干革命黨人隨後也被捲入鬥爭漩渦與此同時，一群四肢發達頭腦簡單的海盜餘黨正伺機向馬如龍報仇

programme.title: 賭神3之少年賭神
programme.desc: 六八年夏天，姓高紗廠老闆敗賭而致家破人亡他的八歲兒子高進從此喪失家園，加入了老千集團跟靳學一切千門技術，十七歲已成為獨當一面的老千高手後來在一次賭神大賽中被師父出賣，並遭槍擊，好友七姑娘與于於在混戰當中受了重傷，高進在連番打擊下決定與師兄傲及靳在賭場上決一死戰

programme.title: 黃飛鴻II之男兒當自強
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與十三姨梁寬在廣州遇到白蓮教徒借扶清滅洋口號，搗亂使館教堂等洋人地盤，連就讀洋校的小學生也不放過，原來是大臣納蘭元述包庇用來對付革命黨黃在一醫學會議中，與革命領袖孫文一見如故，發覺他們對救國更具遠見，決助他們一把逃過厄運，但白蓮教徒卻苦苦相逼

programme.title: 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻偕同十三姨梁寬赴京城與父親黃麒英相敘，並協助開辦寶之林藥廠事宜獅王大會即將舉行，惡霸趙天霸視黃飛鴻為大患，邀黃飛鴻談判時設下重重陷阱欲置黃死地，幸虧黃麒英一干人趕到支援，解除困境趙霸天咄咄逼人，逼使黃飛鴻不能袖手旁觀，決定挺身而出，阻止趙天霸此等敗類奪取獅王美名

programme.title: 大稻埕
programme.desc: 大學生佑熙及歷史系豬教授陰錯陽差穿越時空，回到了1920年代台灣最繁華的大稻埕兩人不僅意外捲入了日本皇太子蒞台蔣渭水抗爭等歷史上至關重要的大事件，更分別跟性格強悍獨力開了間裁縫店的奇女子阿純，以及風華絕代色藝雙全的首席藝旦阿蕊，展開了甜蜜纏綿的跨時代戀曲

programme.title: 蘇乞兒之武功蓋世
programme.desc: 蘇燦出生於軍官家庭，自幼酷愛武術，進京趕武，卻遭禁毒陷害，家破人亡清朝末年，廣東十虎蘇乞兒決戰斧頭幫與江湖大盜，最後創立門派

programme.title: 十月圍城
programme.desc: 1905年，香港在英國人統轄之下已度過數十個年頭，並被定名為維多利亞城華人依然佔人口極大比數，一方面保存了清朝的生活面貌，另一方面又受到西方文化的極大衝擊城中的華藉紳商，漸漸擁有財富與勢力，他們深明在英國政府管轄下，若不主動爭取，將會處處受制，但腐敗顢頇的滿清政府亦無法取得他們的信任於是，他們將希望寄託在滿懷理想，誓要推翻滿清政府的革命黨人身上

programme.title: 記憶大師
programme.desc: 知名作家江豐正面臨與妻子張代晨的婚姻危機，為了不讓自己沉浸在過往，江豐來到了記憶醫療中心欲將過往的回憶取出，沒想到妻子卻要求他將記憶取回才願意離婚重新取回記憶的江豐，卻發現腦海中竟出現一場殺人回憶，江豐像是被捲入深不可測的陷阱中但，這份記憶真的正確嗎？

programme.title: 鬼天廈
programme.desc: 1984年進鑫大樓發生一場惡火，奪走19條性命，此後進鑫大樓恐怖傳言不斷，卻因租金低廉仍吸引許多人入住具有乩身體質的佩芝，因為母親疑似是當年的火災兇手心懷愧疚，決定重回大樓，想憑一己之力撫慰亡靈她與前來尋找靈感的恐怖小說家劭軍開始調查火災真相，然而最終的結果卻讓人毛骨悚然匪夷所思

programme.title: 錢不夠用3：全部夠用
programme.desc: 阿輝阿強與阿煌三個好兄弟各自有了家庭，原本融洽親近的三家人，卻因為對金錢觀與價值觀的改變而開始出現裂痕，尤其在阿煌突然飛黃騰達後，三人感情更加速變質，漸行漸遠，金錢真的是魔鬼嗎？

programme.title: 危城
programme.desc: 民國初年，時值中國內戰軍閥割據亂世時代，一個叫普城的偏遠城鎮，其治安由普城保衛團暫管由於軍閥少帥曹少璘（古天樂飾）殺害三條人命，普城保衛團團長楊克難（劉青雲飾）於是將曹少帥繩之於法，然曹軍財雄勢大，以強權震懾居民，曹軍上校張亦（吳京飾）得悉事件後，趕來普城取人，遇上多年不見之浪人師弟馬鋒（彭于晏飾）馬鋒路見不平欲拔刀相助，卻面臨正義與兄弟情之抉擇

programme.title: 誅仙
programme.desc: 十多年前，草廟村巨變慘遭毀村之災小凡驚羽兩人幸運逃過一劫，被青雲門大竹峰收留，但小凡資質駑鈍，只能淪為打雜為了不讓進度落後的小師弟受到父親責罰，田靈兒總是偷偷教小凡心法，致小凡對靈兒產生好感，然靈兒已有心儀之人，忌妒使得小凡悲喜無常，更引發一場人魔之戰

programme.title: 武俠
programme.desc: 俠客劉金喜隱姓埋名，與妻子阿玉和一雙兒子生活在一處偏遠的小村莊，卻被捲入一樁離奇的命案捕快徐百九是一位武癡，在查案的過程中，嗅到了劉金喜身上必有過人之處不料，卻因為他的好奇，迫使劉金喜面臨和七十二地煞教主的生死對決，他的家庭危在旦夕，他們的家園，遭受滅頂之災

programme.title: 風再起時
programme.desc: 70年代，香港廉政公署成立，對貪污探長進行追捕，揭開殖民地時代落幕前的篇章曾因不收賄而飽受壓迫的員警磊樂與南江，想要改變現狀，攜手建立員警貪污制度，並坐上總華探長位置然而，權力膨脹導致黑白勢力失衡，同時香港廉政公署成立，調查主任李子超對貪污探長展開全球通緝，磊樂與南江隻手遮天的年代走向謝幕風再起時，香港已不同往昔

programme.title: 賭俠
programme.desc: 一年前，賭神高進在公海的一場驚天豪賭擊敗賭魔陳金城後，收小刀為徒一年後，小刀在保鑣龍五陪同下重出江湖，代表師父賭神，以賭技造福慈善事業，遂被封為賭俠另一方面賭聖阿星欲拜賭神為師，遂與其三叔託小刀引見

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: 滿清年間，旗人子弟蘇察哈爾燦目不識丁揮霍成性為贏得丐幫美女如霜芳心，決定上京考武狀元蘇父買通考官由師爺代筆考中武狀元，但被臥底宮中之天理教教主趙無忌揭發舞弊皇帝怒將燦父子貶為乞丐流落街頭，燦又遭趙無忌打成殘廢後燦偶遇丐幫長老洪日慶授以睡夢羅漢拳，如霜被趙無忌擄走，燦以睡夢羅漢拳奪得幫主之位，率眾迎戰造反之趙無忌，終於領悟降龍十八掌

programme.title: 代號：鐵鉻行動
programme.desc: 1950年6月北韓南侵，南韓節節敗退為了扭轉戰局，麥克阿瑟將軍策動鐵鉻行動，秘密派遣KLO部隊滲透北韓偵查情報海軍上尉張學修領軍潛入敵陣，卻遭北韓司令林杰振懷疑，任務即將曝光時間僅剩24小時，攸關朝鮮半島歷史與命運的鐵鉻行動就此展開！

programme.title: 迴路戰場
programme.desc: 在意外殺死一位有權有勢的執行長孫子後，一對夫妻被迫為了自己的生命而戰或逃之夭夭這名復仇心切的商人聘請了黑幫首領剷除他們，賞金高達100萬美元，吸引了全世界最致命刺客不惜代價奪取獎金，一場無情的貓捉老鼠遊戲就此展開

programme.title: 在AI世界與你再戀
programme.desc: 專研AI人工智慧的她無法接受男友驟逝，夜不成眠時發現了一款AI軟件能將真實世界和虛擬世界無縫接軌，如此一來便可沉浸在已故戀人的永恆之愛中然而，一名資安專家卻愛上了她，他該選擇優先讓公司順利上市或是及時拯救她回到現實世界？

programme.title: 夜魔駛
programme.desc: 表面上是一介平凡司機的他，真實身份竟是通緝犯，多年來始終靠著一套嚴謹規則安全隱身但當他被迫打破規則後，骨牌效應開始發酵，成功與失敗的距離只有毫釐之差

programme.title: 梵蒂岡：聖杯的考驗
programme.desc: 1943年，一群芬蘭志願者參與了一場由梵蒂岡主教所策劃的尋寶行動隨著旅程深入東方邊境，即將成為神父的米勒考斯基必須判斷這場任務究竟是一場神的召喚抑或是可怕的詛咒

programme.title: 獵殺侏儸紀
programme.desc: 2030年第三次世界大戰期間，一群倖存者逃入一座地下碉堡兩年後，他們必須離開碉堡找尋補給，但隨之而來的卻是恐龍的獵殺

programme.title: 迫切救援
programme.desc: 在美國與墨西哥相接的邊境四個州之中，德州發生最多起非法移民死亡案件，邊緣城市受到毒品黑幫與人口販賣的威脅也層出不窮一名甫畢業的女孩在畢業晚會回家途中遭到綁架，她的哥哥萊恩必須與時間賽跑，要從專門販賣年輕女孩的人口販子手中救回妹妹，在她被人蛇集團吞噬並消失在這世界之前

programme.title: 非法地帶
programme.desc: 為了紀念父親而登山的夏儂（傑米金飾演）無意間撞見當地警察的違法勾當，這些警察不僅介入毒品交易，甚至不惜殺人滅口夏儂將犯罪過程拍了下來，卻被當場發現，一場驚心動魄的追逐就此展開而身經百戰的資深警察傑克（布魯斯威利飾演）也恰巧捲入這場衝突，他將不惜一切代價聲張正義，將罪犯繩之以法

programme.title: 我出去醫下
programme.desc: 前無國界醫生賽吉是唯一一位會在聖誕夜出診的醫生，他跟美食外送員馬利克發生了車禍雖然被撞的是馬利克，但卻引發了賽吉的坐骨神經痛，情急之下，馬利克只好代替賽吉登門看診於是他戴上AirPods，透過賽吉的隔空電話指導，搖身一變成為超瞎醫生！

programme.title: 外星汪汪隊
programme.desc: 三個外星人意外墜落地球後，為了隱藏身分，化身為可愛的三隻狗狗兩位小孩發現了他們的祕密，答應協助他們修好太空船他們一起經歷好玩的冒險，成為形影不離的好朋友不過他們的任務被一個太空迷破壞了為了避免身分被曝光，太空汪汪隊與孩子們必須分秒必爭，修好太空船及時返家

programme.title: 追殺胖老爹
programme.desc: 聖誕老人克里斯（梅爾吉勃遜飾）隨著年紀增長，事業也跟著逐年下滑為了拯救聖誕工廠，並養活他的小精靈員工，他被迫與美軍合作，轉行開始製造軍武然而不過是一次失誤，竟讓他惹來殺身之禍？！原來就在聖誕節早晨，一位富家少爺滿心期待地打開聖誕禮物，卻發現禮物只是一塊煤炭，於是決定雇用職業殺手，獵殺這位讓他火冒三丈的聖誕老人！屁孩PK聖誕老人，這場佳節攻防究竟誰輸誰贏？

programme.title: 黑獄戰場
programme.desc: 為了替遭殘忍謀殺的家人復仇，傑克不顧自己警察身分，精心策畫一宗銀行搶案，讓自己被送進兇手巴拉姆所在的監獄但傑克入獄後才發現，巴拉姆早已掌握整座監獄的運作，在牢中享有帝王般的待遇，更受到獄方層層保護，而巴拉姆得知傑克入獄，也派出殺手欲置傑克於死地，正當孤立無援的傑克無計可施之時，FBI臥底威廉提出兩人聯手對抗巴拉姆的計畫究竟威廉真正的意圖為何？傑克又能否殺出重圍，一償復仇宿願？

programme.title: 致命彈片
programme.desc: 前海軍陸戰隊員與他的老戰友槓上墨西哥販毒集團，試圖找出失蹤女兒的下落

programme.title: 霹靂煞首
programme.desc: 十多歲的少女妮基塔年紀輕輕即染上毒癮，搶劫偷竊都是生活中的家常便飯某天毒癮發作的她意外殺死一名警察，在妮基塔面臨處決之際，被政府探員看中，要赦免她的死刑，代價是她必須隱姓埋名為國家賣命身手矯健的她很快成為出色的秘密殺手，直到遇見了心愛的他，讓妮基塔萌生了金盆洗手的念頭，卻沒想到最後一個任務竟是如此艱難

programme.title: 搶救巴迪
programme.desc: 史帝夫是一名住在威尼斯的私家偵探，每天與他的愛犬巴迪一同辦案，而在某天巴迪突然消失蹤影，追查之下發現是被史蒂夫曾經得罪過的刀幫毒梟蜘蛛綁架了，為了帶回愛犬，史蒂夫必須幫助蜘蛛奪回毒品，開啟了一趟玩命到底甚至全裸帶槍上陣的旅程！

programme.title: 假球風暴
programme.desc: 職業足球員杰梅因染上賭博，他將自己賺的錢全投進賭局導致賭債越滾越大，在他焦頭爛額時一個集團表示只要幫助集團賺錢就能還債，為了恢復正常生活杰梅因拚盡全力的踢假球？

programme.title: 緊急撤離
programme.desc: 伊拉克入侵伊朗初期，阿巴丹當地一家廣播電台裡的一群年輕人，試圖在薩達姆軍隊的炮擊和轟炸下維持電台運作，同時為人們帶來希望

programme.title: 心悸效應
programme.desc: 田徑冠軍跑者謝爾蓋，在一場失速狂飆的車禍意外後失去了女友失意的他開始把自己隱藏起來，但身邊卻開始發生一連串殺人事件，而證據都顯示嫌疑犯就是他警探安娜絲塔承辦此連環殺人案，覺得事有蹊翹，便開始和急欲洗清罪嫌的謝爾蓋合作追查真相謝爾蓋某次慢跑時意外發現，自己透過跑步讓心跳持續上升超過極限後，竟可以短暫穿越時間回到過去於是他們利用這個能力，逐漸深入真相，發現背後其實另有真凶

programme.title: 舊愛靈靈妻
programme.desc: 文思枯竭的作家查爾斯，為了新書取材，竟將腦筋動到怪力亂神領域，邀請靈媒阿卡蒂夫人到他家舉辦招魂儀式，卻萬萬沒想到，這場儀式竟讓他已逝的亡妻艾薇拉因此還魂眼看查爾斯與艾薇拉的亡魂即將舊情復燃，現任妻子露絲在擔憂查爾斯人鬼外遇之際，更發現艾薇拉竟打算把查爾斯一起拖入陰間

programme.title: 時空交戰
programme.desc: 二位上古神明和敵人對戰時，意外在時空漩渦中墜落，發現自己身處當今世界只有一名年輕女孩，據說她的眼睛可以看清一切並擁有強大的力量，只有她才能送他們回自己的時空以拯救諸神人類還有動物；否則所有生命皆將逝去

programme.title: 奮戰到底
programme.desc: 從ISIS偵詢中倖存的兩名海軍陸戰隊員返家，克里斯努力回歸正常生活，貝爾又回到了多年前熟悉的混合武術世界，尋找值得為之生存的戰鬥值得背水一戰的未來，離開戰事的軍員還能找到生存的價值嗎？

programme.title: 黑豹救援軍
programme.desc: 二戰期間，喬治巴頓將軍帶領著他的第三支美軍一路越過法國邊境，殺進納粹德國希特勒為了攔阻敵軍前進，出動了秘密武器Me262戰鬥機一場空中大戰隨即展開弗蘭克羅斯中尉駕駛著這場空戰的其中一架美軍戰機，眼看已敵不過納粹的猛烈襲擊，只好迫降在敵軍陣地內，在等待援兵的同時，非裔駕駛坦克前來營救為了贏得這場戰爭，他們必須將種族差異擱置一邊

programme.title: 雪國奇遇記
programme.desc: 來自城市的小牛琪拉，第一次到爸爸的農舍跟他一起過聖誕但她的爸爸不是那種會慶祝節日的人，所以她有點失望她的爸爸突然接到附近住戶的電話，說是被雪困住，需要他過去幫忙剷雪琪拉認為她剛好可以借此機會好好佈置牛牛山莊，並在一個調皮的守護神的幫助下，讓家裡充滿聖誕節的氣氛琪拉最終領悟到，聖誕節最重要的是能夠與親朋好友團聚一堂

programme.title: 波伽利：聲命之歌
programme.desc: 阿莫斯生來就擁有美妙嗓音，卻因為先天性眼疾進入盲人學校，之後又在一場足球比賽意外後完全失明個性好強的他，卻從未因此放棄自己對音樂的熱情與夢想在恩師（安東尼奧班德拉斯飾）的嚴厲指導下，他的歌唱技巧不斷提升與突破，終於獲得義大利國寶級搖滾明星蘇奇洛賞識，親自邀他同台獻唱，此後開始朝史上最成功的跨界男高音之路邁進

programme.title: 終結戰
programme.desc: 一位項上人頭遭到懸賞的年輕美國警察為了替亡師報仇血恨，與一名泰國傭兵聯手合作當他發現自己正與該國最惡名昭彰的冷酷罪犯正面交峰時，他的任務轉瞬之間變得無比凶險

programme.title: 星光首映場霹靂煞
programme.desc: 十多歲的少女妮基塔年紀輕輕即染上毒癮，搶劫偷竊都是生活中的家常便飯某天毒癮發作的她意外殺死一名警察，在妮基塔面臨處決之際，被政府探員看中，要赦免她的死刑，代價是她必須隱姓埋名為國家賣命身手矯健的她很快成為出色的秘密殺手，直到遇見了心愛的他，讓妮基塔萌生了金盆洗手的念頭，卻沒想到最後一個任務竟是如此艱難

programme.title: 西蒙娜：世紀之聲
programme.desc: 20世紀法國最傑出的女性之一：西蒙娜韋依（Simone Veil）的傳記電影從韋依的童年時期到她的政治奮鬥，經歷數起20世紀的重大事件私密而史詩般地呈現一位非凡的女性，如何挑戰並改變她的時代西蒙娜韋依所捍衛的人文理念，時至今日仍無比重要

programme.title: 大不列顛之戰
programme.desc: 二戰初期，在歐陸發動閃電戰術的納粹德軍大獲全勝，而英軍經歷了敦克爾克大撤退後，裝備短缺信心動搖希特勒向英國喊話勸降，否則將進行攻占；英國首相邱吉爾隨即在下議院發表演說，大不列顛之戰正式展開最終英國皇家空軍靠著有限戰機與靈活戰術，力抗德軍優勢的空中武力，讓希特勒首度嚐到挫敗，適時阻止納粹入侵英國的野心

programme.title: 十三太保
programme.desc: 唐末，黃巢起義軍攻入唐首都長安，晉王李克用受命剿賊，收覆都城沙陀族人李克用其時擁兵十萬，麾下猛將如雲，更有義子組成的十三太保能征善戰，風光一時其中十一太保史敬思與十三太保李存孝武功最為高強，令梁王朱溫極其忌憚而設宴暗算最終，昔日威震天下的大同邊將戰死大半，令人唏噓

programme.title: 七月與安生
programme.desc: 恬靜如水的林七月與張揚似火的李安生，兩人從中學開始成為如膠似漆的好友，直到18歲那年兩人同時愛上了蘇家明為了友誼，安生選擇遠離家鄉四處流浪，唯一聯繫她們的，是不曾中斷書寫的明信片兩個女孩的友誼以一種奇特的方式延續，既有思念，更有顧忌然而，家明始終是她們之間無法逾越的一道坎

programme.title: 633轟炸大隊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，挪威反抗軍領袖艾利克冒死劫機逃至英國，帶來德軍在挪威秘密研發飛彈準備對盟軍展開致命攻擊的情報英軍命令格蘭特指揮官的蚊式戰鬥轟炸機633中隊，執行摧毀德軍隱身在挪威險峻峽灣飛彈工廠的任務艾利克奉命返回挪威帶領反抗軍破壞保護工廠的防空陣地，卻不幸被蓋世太保所擄並遭嚴刑拷問；消息傳回英國，為避免任務曝光急命633中隊全員出動救援

programme.title: 威龍闖天關
programme.desc: 清朝道光至咸豐年間，廣州名狀師宋世傑為求生計，專替有罪富人打官司脫罪，巧言善辯顛倒是非，因而遭天譴，與心地善良卻潑辣正義的妻子屢次喪子封筆從善後，宋在妻子感召下重出江湖，為寡婦楊秀珍仗義伸冤，在官官相衛下，夫妻聯手機智辯案，揭穿黑幕，終令惡人伏法，善有善報，兒孫滿堂

programme.title: 浴血奮戰
programme.desc: 浴血奮戰是一部歷史動作片，講述了土耳其奧斯曼帝國烏克蘭酋長國以及俄羅斯帝國之間的戰爭史事各方勢力企圖掌控哈西貝城，一座位於烏克蘭酋長國中心黑海沿岸堅不可摧的堡壘，就在俄羅斯人認為即將贏得勝利時，一位神秘勇敢的哥薩克戰士安德烈來到伊斯坦堡，傳達來自烏克蘭酋長國領導人的秘密信息，而永遠改變了這場戰鬥的終局

programme.title: 外太空九號計畫
programme.desc: 由於地球政府不願承認外星人的存在，並研發可能摧毀宇宙的太陽彈，於是外星指揮官啟動外太空九號計劃，準備讓活屍大軍進攻球所幸奉命調查的美軍上校轄區警長與目擊民航機師三人，與外星人在飛碟機艙內打鬥而造成失火，最終導致飛碟在逃離地球時於空中爆炸，這才適時解除危機！

programme.title: 藍徽特攻隊
programme.desc: 一戰末期德軍在西部前線戰事吃緊，畢業於104飛行學校的史達赫中尉來到了威利上尉的飛行中隊當時飛行員最高榮譽是擊落敵機二十架可獲頒藍色徽章史達赫在首次任務就擊落英軍飛機一架，卻未得到陸軍證實而不算，但史達赫的戰功並未因此停滯不前；最終，史達赫榮獲最高榮譽，卻在授予藍色勳章那天，有人向元帥爆料史達赫紀錄不實的內幕，中隊長決定把他送至柏林軍事法庭究責

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳II：父子情仇
programme.desc: 五億探長雷洛傳續集，得到岳父之助東山再起的雷洛（劉德華飾）），在警界鬥爭後升上全港總華探長，坐擁大權香港展開反貪污大行動，雷洛卻在此時遇上了失散的舊情人與擔任廉政專員的兒子（郭富城飾），展開一場父子鬥爭

programme.title: 威龍闖天關
programme.desc: 清朝道光至咸豐年間，廣州名狀師宋世傑為求生計，專替有罪富人打官司脫罪，巧言善辯顛倒是非，因而遭天譴，與心地善良卻潑辣正義的妻子屢次喪子封筆從善後，宋在妻子感召下重出江湖，為寡婦楊秀珍仗義伸冤，在官官相衛下，夫妻聯手機智辯案，揭穿黑幕，終令惡人伏法，善有善報，兒孫滿堂

programme.title: 大進擊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，英國轟炸中隊於巴黎上空執行轟炸任務，其中一架轟炸機被德軍擊中，飛行員被迫跳傘逃生，並約好在清真寺旁的土耳其浴室會合其中三名英軍分別降落在動物園水池歌劇院，以及正在重新粉刷的納粹祕密警察總部屋頂，在動物園管理員歌劇院樂團指揮與油漆工幫助下逃生而樂團指揮和油漆工，更陰錯陽差隨著三名英軍飛行員，與德軍展開了一場場驚險刺激的逃亡之旅！

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之鐵雞鬥蜈蚣
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻結識尋找妹妹的鐵燕父女，鐵燕父女發現朝廷的捕快正和僧人在商議販賣人口的計策但不料行蹤被發現，結果父親被打傷，女兒只好逃出去向黃飛鴻求救

programme.title: 南北少林
programme.desc: 清朝奸臣赫索王爺陷害忠良，兩家遺孤被迫分開男嬰被托孤至北少林出家為僧，名為智明；女嬰則隨長輩隱居南少林，名為司馬燕兩人各自苦練武藝，於赫索壽宴上巧合相遇並刺殺未遂後司馬燕不幸被捕，智明與南少林弟子趙威合力營救，南北少林同門最終齊心合力擊殺赫索報得大仇

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產雙語版
programme.desc: 拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子 老父親再婚年輕單親媽80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向

programme.title: 小娘惹之翡翠山
programme.desc: 新加坡年度收視冠軍! 翡翠山豪門三兄弟爭產風暴2026年紅星大獎, 最佳導演 最佳劇本1950年代的翡翠山，張家是名門望族，卻暗藏著一場場愛恨與權力角力千金張安雅幼年遭拐，淪落妓院，歷盡磨難；流浪乞兒張心娘意外被收養，從此改變命運；被視為掃把星的張安娜重返張家後性情大變，掀起家族風暴另一方面，張家三兄弟為家業明爭暗鬥，大哥張金海無心經商，二哥張金河苦撐家業，小弟張金泉卻野心勃勃三位娘惹在親情愛情與權力的漩渦中彼此糾纏，為改寫命運，展開一場驚心動魄的家族較量

programme.title: 輕年
programme.desc: 霍建華依然單身且毒舌 兄弟情打鬧中共創業上市公司副總馬丁表面風光，卻在事業頂峰突罹腦瘤面對生命倒數，他回國重尋豹房胡同四兄弟，試圖解開高中分道揚鑣的心結然而昔日手足早已各有難關：春生陷入孩子教育焦慮連寶遭逢中年裁員風暴童秋則困於婚姻催生壓力當這群陷在健康事業與家庭泥濘的大叔再次聚首，決定放下芥蒂攜手創業，共同重啟人生新副本！

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎

programme.title: On air首
programme.desc: 金荷娜On air詮釋辛辣女星 與編劇導演經紀人上演修羅場！傲氣女星吳升雅外冷內熱，渴望被理解；毒舌編劇徐英恩辛辣犀利，因背叛築起心牆；導演李慶民冷面苛刻，與英恩有難解過往；經紀人張基俊圓融細膩，總在混亂中守住分寸四人因同一部劇合作，從爭執碰撞試探，到逐漸看見彼此的脆弱與真心升雅卸下武裝英恩學會柔軟慶民面對情感基俊守住信念他們不只拍戲，更在現場演繹真實人生

programme.desc: 拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子 老父親再婚年輕單親媽80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向

programme.title: 夫婦的世界首
programme.desc: 閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎

programme.title: 小娘惹之翡翠山新
programme.desc: 新加坡年度收視冠軍! 翡翠山豪門三兄弟爭產風暴2026年紅星大獎, 最佳導演 最佳劇本1951年代的翡翠山，張家是名門望族，卻暗藏著一場場愛恨與權力角力千金張安雅幼年遭拐，淪落妓院，歷盡磨難；流浪乞兒張心娘意外被收養，從此改變命運；被視為掃把星的張安娜重返張家後性情大變，掀起家族風暴另一方面，張家三兄弟為家業明爭暗鬥，大哥張金海無心經商，二哥張金河苦撐家業，小弟張金泉卻野心勃勃三位娘惹在親情愛情與權力的漩渦中彼此糾纏，為改寫命運，展開一場驚心動魄的家族較量

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 千億遺產考驗 林智妍淪落魄千金 竟遭林秀香假冒身分一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 南風知我意

programme.desc: 蓮花樓成毅在搭張予曦，再現與君歌絕美默契！！藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 千億遺產考驗 林智妍淪落魄千金 竟遭林秀香假冒身分一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 熱血軍檢完
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 新紮師妹粵普

programme.title: 胭脂扣粵
programme.desc: 1934年的香港.陳振邦十二少張國榮 飾是南北行海味店的太子爺,是個經常出入鴉片煙窟,風月場所的花花公子,他遇上了石塘咀倚紅樓紅牌阿姑名妓如花梅艷芳 飾,二人旋即陷入熱戀.但是,十二少的父母不接納他們的關係,希望十二少可以與其表妹淑賢溫碧霞 飾結婚承繼家業,十二少在如花的幫助下學戲但不成功.最後在山窮水盡下,於1934年3月8日晚上11時,十二少與如花吞食鴉片殉情自盡...

programme.title: 無雙粵普
programme.desc: 偽鈔畫師李問在泰國因製作假鈔,遭人密報被捕入獄.香港警方將他引渡回港,當律政司要檢控之際,國寶級畫家阮文前來保釋,雙方達成協議 - 如果李問能夠供出偽鈔集團主腦畫家真正身份,便可轉為污點證人.故事開始追溯至1985年的溫哥華,李問跟阮文本是一對情侶畫家,其後阮文的作品受人欣賞且擁有專屬經紀人,然而李問卻因為作品原創性不足,只能靠偷偷製作仿真畫維生.有回無意間被阮文戳破,雙方起了爭執,兩人漸行...

programme.title: 阿二一族粵

programme.title: 阿郎的故事粵
programme.desc: 浪子阿郎周潤發 飾是一個出色的電單車賽車手.富家出身的女友波波張艾嘉 飾對他一往情深,無視他的缺點,不顧母親的反對,和他相戀同居,繼而未婚懷孕.然而,放蕩不羈的阿郎依然故我,在波波懷孕時,還出軌跟另一個女子親熱,波波發現後憤然離開阿郎,阿郎一怒之下毆打身懷六甲的波波,波波更摔下樓梯險些兒流產.波波臨盆之際,阿郎依然去參加非法賽車,結果因撞向路障後翻車而被捕,入獄兩年.波波的母親串...

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星粵
programme.desc: 茶壺,死氣喉,凡士林,鬈毛積及劉克司五人出獄後決定改邪歸正,與鬈毛積的妹妹妹頭同組五寶清潔公司.某次匪徒正交易偽鈔電版時遇上劫匪,剛巧被 CID 看見便一路追趕,後劫匪情急下將電版拋進五福星之清潔車中.五寶開始被兩大反派追殺,最後五福星施展奇謀妙計應付兩大反派.

programme.title: 星月童話粵普
programme.desc: 瞳,廿五歲,溫柔可人.一次交通意外奪去了瞳的未婚夫達也,但她相信達也仍然未死,他一定在某處等著她.瞳隻身遠赴香港,在這裡她竟遇上了一個與達也長得一模一樣的男子-家寶.家寶是個出色的探員,可是他的女朋友抵受不了他的工作狂熱,感到孤獨而自殺,令家寶內疚非常...

programme.title: 喜愛夜蒲粵普
programme.desc: 蘭桂坊常客Steven遇上空姐Jennifer,二人發生一夜情.但他們感覺今次真的戀愛了,可惜因為誤會令Jennifer心灰意冷下決定絕跡蘭桂坊.事隔八個月,二人重遇,Steven更希望能夠與她發展,可惜...

programme.title: 好女十八嫁粵普

Thanks to a rare alignment of the planets in 1976, Voyager 2 was sent for mankinds only flyby of these ice worlds. programme.title: WTOs Okonjo-Iweala on Why Globalization Needs a Rethink
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua speaks with Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala about fighting corruption, the personal cost of her work - including her mothers abduction - and leading the WTO through unprecedented trade tensions.

programme.title: How Blackstone Changed Private Equity Forever
programme.desc: Blackstone CEO Stephen Schwarzman helped private equity go from niche to mainstream. He talks about how he spots investment opportunities and where the world will shift next.

programme.title: How to Run Your Familys 1.6 Trillion Empire
programme.desc: Francine Lacqua talks with Franklin Templeton CEO Jenny Johnson about how to steer a 1.6 trillion business amid the rise of AI, shifting politics and booming private markets.

programme.title: Inside Europes Economic Crises With Christine Lagarde
programme.desc: Bloombergs award-winning anchor sits down with the decision-makers shaping our future to explore the personal stories behind their public personas.

programme.title: Ajay Banga on India, Migration and a Youth Jobs Time Bomb
programme.desc: What drives the worlds most influential minds? In Leaders with Francine Lacqua, we sit down with the decision-makers shaping our future to explore the personal stories behind their public personas.

programme.title: Who Really Holds the Power in Entertainment? Reza Izad
programme.desc: Hollywood needed its biggest stars. Does YouTube? Reza Izad joins Ian Schafer on Post Credits to explore who holds the power as the creator economy and Hollywood converge.

programme.title: Inside the Legal Fight Against Trumps Deportation Campaign
programme.desc: A year following a group of lawyers as they sue the Department of Homeland Security and scramble to help free those arrested under Donald Trumps immigration policies.

programme.title: Corruption as Cancer
programme.desc: The Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission is supposed to root out graft. Instead, some of its members have been accused of perpetuating the very wrongdoing they were meant to stop.

programme.title: The Making of a Chinese Spy
programme.desc: Ji Chaoqun was a promising young engineer from Beijing heading to the US to study. Then Chinas spy agency came calling with bags of cash, the promise of glory and an offer that would change his life forever.

programme.title: The Zombie Debts Making Wall Street Rich
programme.desc: A police raid in a small town in the Philippines revealed a young mayors alleged connections to a 2 billion Singapore money laundering scandal and Chinese espionage.

programme.title: The Scandal That Rocked the Philippines
programme.desc: A police raid in a small town in the Philippines revealed a young mayors alleged connections to a 2 billion Singapore money laundering scandal and Chinese espionage.

programme.title: South Korea
programme.desc: Hannah Fry visits South Korea to explore how it became a cultural and tech superpower. She trains with a Taekwondo blackbelt, learns kimchi secrets from a grandmaster and dives into pro gaming.

programme.title: Ancient Greece
programme.desc: Hannah Fry reveals why ancient Greece was the birthplace of so many big ideas. She decodes the Parthenons geometry, sails the Aegean with ancient tools and is swept up in a riotous festival.

programme.title: Ireland
programme.desc: Hannah Fry journeys to Ireland, her ancestral homeland, tracing the impact of the nations modern economic transformation and its connections to the land and sea.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Hannah Fry reveals how Icelands geological extremes help shape its culture. She meets scientists predicting lava flows and harnessing geothermal power, and even rides along ancient Viking trails.

programme.title: Super Intelligence
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence has begun to exhibit early signs of agency. Are we on a path to superintelligence? Self destruction? Or is the potential promise and threat of AI being overblown?

programme.title: Animal Communication
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI are revealing how animals communicate, and may soon allow us to talk to them. What can we learn from wildlife, and should we be talking to the animals at all?

programme.title: Quantum Computing
programme.desc: With the promise of unimaginable computing power, a global race for quantum supremacy is raging. Who will be first to harness this new technological force, and what will they do with it?

programme.title: Water
programme.desc: Water. Our survival depends on water, yet global reserves are rapidly shrinking. Can technology help secure humanitys future water needs?

programme.title: Pain
programme.desc: For some, pain is excruciating and inescapable. But amid the continuing fallout of the opioid crisis, new technologies are being developed to limit and even eliminate pain.

programme.title: Next Billion
programme.desc: Soon, another billion people will be online. How will these new users embrace this technology to transform their lives, and what will it mean for the rest of the world?

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance Radio
programme.desc: The economy and the markets are under surveillance as we cover the latest in finance, economics and investment. Join Tom Keene, Paul Sweeney, Lisa Mateo, Michael Barr and other guests.

programme.title: Bloomberg Intelligence

programme.title: Balance of Power

programme.title: How China Plans to Turn Its Factories Green
programme.desc: The zero-carbon industrial park is one of Chinas recent tactics to decarbonize its factories through renewable power. Can its nascent technology move China into a greener era of mass production?

programme.title: Can Microbes Solve the Copper Problem?
programme.desc: The global copper supply is on a collision course with growing electricity demand. Now some companies are turning to biomining, the process of using microbes to extract metals, to boost supply.

programme.title: Inside a Giant Electric Ferry
programme.desc: While electric vehicles have gone mainstream, shipping has lagged behind. But now, the humble passenger ferry may be the most primed to make battery-powered boats a viable option.

programme.title: AI Is Pushing Chipmaking to Its Limits
programme.desc: Semiconductors power modern technology, from AI to everyday devices. Now, global tensions and rising demand are forcing the chip supply chain to adapt.

programme.title: The Race to Fuel a Nuclear Energy Comeback

programme.title: 马哥波罗

programme.title: 青春鼓王

programme.title: 萧十一郎

programme.title: 如来神掌

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第11集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第14集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第2集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第10集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第12集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第14集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第2集
programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第10集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第12集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.desc: 王甫芬医生张家辉为完成女友彤梁咏琪的遗愿而加入国际救援组织生命动力，其后更成立以平民为对象的龙城医疗中心芬随组织在肯尼亚工作时，认识了年轻的齐百恒林峰医生原本在私家医院凌霄医院任职的恒其后亦受芬影响而加入龙城芬以病人为先的精神不但感染了恒，亦叫在凌霄当护士的康乔郭羡妮心仪，可惜芬始终忘不了彤另方面，恒在非洲认识了义工夏晓晴唐宁，对她留下了深刻的印象；其后二人再在龙城相遇，惟晴却因恒身边的富家女高小柔陈敏之而却步恒跟随芬在龙城及生命动力工作，明白到医生除了医病亦能帮助病人活出生命的意义可能医者真的不能自医，助人无数的恒和芬在面对自己的人生挑战时，也有无助的时候......

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第11集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第13集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第13集
programme.desc: 妻子章蕙芯李佳芯饰死于一宗司机醉驾事故后，救护总队目麦在田马德钟饰跟独女诺儿姐姐爱花张文慈饰小姨章可祈刘佩钥饰共同生活在田因丧妻一事痛恨不守规矩任意妄为的人和事，公事上铁面无私！新下属卓家杰何广沛饰为人冲动，与在田常生磨擦此外，调任见习救护主任的上级谭家俊罗天宇饰凡事追求完美，更处处针对家杰，令队员压力大增；在田作为中间桥梁，苦心经营，力求维系队员的团结及合作精神，同时希望培育出色的救护精英，在不同个案挑战中，抢救更多宝贵的生命......

programme.desc: 缉毒精英陈泰桦老米阿峰与阿棠奉命秘密缉捕跨国毒枭，却因队内黑警泄密，行动甫展开便落入圈套阿峰当场殉职，队长卢Sir壮烈牺牲，阿棠则神秘失踪，兄弟情谊自此崩离多年后，幸存的陈泰桦与老米誓要查明真相，连手追缉潜伏多年的内鬼，为牺牲的兄弟讨回血债

programme.title: BBS乡民的正义Silent Code
programme.desc: 记者蓝苡晴授命在网络上找新闻，意外闯入超红的BBS网络论坛李澄湘是创立梦想板的板主，原意是让网友们分享彼此的梦想，却因为一段不该外流的影片而成为人肉搜索的主角苡晴一路追查下去，发现事实的真相越来越复杂

programme.title: P风暴P Storm
programme.desc: 廖雨萍向廉政公署举报一个富二代在监狱中行贿惩教人员，以包庇他和其团伙在狱中的恶行廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉以囚犯的卧底身份入狱调查尽管监狱危机四伏，陆志廉决定在狱友王蓝禄的帮助下，完成他的任务

programme.title: 靠近我一点.I Believe
programme.desc: 等了初恋男友10年的林楚楚，最终等来的是男友和别人的婚礼正当她对感情失去信心的时候，一位婚礼策划师和一位高富帅男神同时出现在楚楚的生活中，陪她走出了这段黑暗时光面对同样真挚的两个人，楚楚的感情也来到了必须抉择的十字路口，她最后会如何抉择？

programme.title: 天水围的日与夜The Way We Are
programme.desc: 以座落城市边陲的天水围为背景，在超市工作的中年寡妇贵姐与儿子俩相依为命，日子过得恬淡质朴却不失温情贵姐遇上刚搬进天水围的独居老妇，建立起邻里情谊，更助她融入新生活

programme.title: 12怪盗WE12
programme.desc: 地下组织怪盗公会一直维持着全球的秩序组织内有12个天才怪盗各自身怀绝技，独立行事多时，各有各忙，所以默契欠奉12人必须重新燃起团魂，以完成拯救世界免于灾难的使命

programme.title: 智齿Limbo
programme.desc: 一宗凶残的连环杀人案震惊全港，经验丰富的警察斩哥与年轻督察任凯被委派调查此案在调查过程中，他们遇到了王桃，并发现她意外害死了斩哥的妻子为了赎回过失，王桃决定协助他们追捕连环杀手，却最终将自己置于极大的危险之中

programme.title: 婚内婚外Married
programme.desc: 公益律师宁悦渐渐发现自己的生活其实一直在无微不至的丈夫胡成的控制之下，他隐藏在完美表象下的种种越矩行为也让宁悦看清了自己婚姻的真相在愤怒之余，宁悦终于清醒，尝试从这段维持了五年的美满婚姻中挣脱出来而在找回自我尝试独立的过程中，宁悦遇到了同为律师的秦灿，正直阳光的他在宁悦成长的过程中提供了诸多帮助然而控制欲极强的胡成却不满于宁悦私下的异常举动，夫妻二人关于婚姻的战斗就此打响

programme.title: 香港探秘地图The Map Of Truth
programme.desc: 玄学家庄一臣靠撞鬼事件爆红，更组建探秘团队追查连串灵异怪事打假网红毕萍为揭穿他的真面目加入团队，却在一次次诡秘经历中发现他不为人知的一面与此同时，富豪之子离奇失踪，一场真假玄学交锋悄然展开Master Zhuang, a feng shui expert, gains fame through his channel exploring Hong Kongs mysterious sites, but his rise is challenged by a skeptical influencer determined to expose him. When a tycoons son mysteriously vanishes, an eerie mystery begins to unfold

programme.title: 但愿人长久Teresa Teng
programme.desc: 本剧以邓丽君真人故事改编，讲述了华语世界永恒的声音邓丽君的传奇追梦历程，并展现了她从一个平凡的小女孩成长为走上世界舞台的超级女声的奋斗之路 Based on the life of legendary singer Teresa Teng, this biopic drama series follows her triumphant and successful career as one of Asias most popular and revered singer to the trials and tribulations in her personal life.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

One struggling against fate, the other concealing power behind a faade, the two join forces to survive.

programme.title: 灼灼韶华Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人重诺守信的女商人This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 有生之年Living
programme.desc: 落魄的高嘉岳突然回家了，离家多年后回来，嘉岳发现其实家中每个人都有各自的不同难题：爸妈感情失和二弟在家中没有归属感三弟对未来很茫然，但他们还是跌跌撞撞地在人生道路上前进着眼看家人都这么尽力地活着，嘉岳认为是时候去完成轻生的打算了台湾Netflix的爆红剧，由金马影帝吴慷仁影后杨贵媚及金钟男配角喜翔女配角孙可芳领衔主演，不容错过！

programme.title: 纯真年代的爱情Love Story in the 1970s
programme.desc: 七十年代，积极上进的女工费霓一心想上大学改变命运费霓的同学方穆扬因救人受伤成为了见义勇为的英雄，费霓主动照顾他，想以好事评先被推荐上大学，但希望屡次落空现实的压力接踵而至，为了帮哥哥解决婚房的难题，费霓向方穆扬提出假结婚分房几经波折二人终于有了自己的房子，成为了睡上下铺的小夫妻，他们共同面对困难，鼓励彼此追梦，也在平淡温馨的生活中滋长了情投意合的浪漫最终费霓终如愿上了大学，方穆扬也实现了自己的画家梦想In the 70s, Fei Ni, a female worker wanted to go to college to change her fate. programme.title: 香港探秘地图The Map Of Truth
programme.desc: 玄学家庄一臣靠撞鬼事件爆红，更组建探秘团队追查连串灵异怪事打假网红毕萍为揭穿他的真面目加入团队，却在一次次诡秘经历中发现他不为人知的一面与此同时，富豪之子离奇失踪，一场真假玄学交锋悄然展开Master Zhuang, a feng shui expert, gains fame through his channel exploring Hong Kongs mysterious sites, but his rise is challenged by a skeptical influencer determined to expose him. When a tycoons son mysteriously vanishes, an eerie mystery begins to unfold

programme.title: 但愿人长久Teresa Teng
programme.desc: 本剧以邓丽君真人故事改编，讲述了华语世界永恒的声音邓丽君的传奇追梦历程，并展现了她从一个平凡的小女孩成长为走上世界舞台的超级女声的奋斗之路 Based on the life of legendary singer Teresa Teng, this biopic drama series follows her triumphant and successful career as one of Asias most popular and revered singer to the trials and tribulations in her personal life.

programme.title: 婚内婚外Married
programme.desc: 公益律师宁悦渐渐发现自己的生活其实一直在无微不至的丈夫胡成的控制之下，他隐藏在完美表象下的种种越矩行为也让宁悦看清了自己婚姻的真相在愤怒之余，宁悦终于清醒，尝试从这段维持了五年的美满婚姻中挣脱出来而在找回自我尝试独立的过程中，宁悦遇到了同为律师的秦灿，正直阳光的他在宁悦成长的过程中提供了诸多帮助然而控制欲极强的胡成却不满于宁悦私下的异常举动，夫妻二人关于婚姻的战斗就此打响

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀Glory of Love

programme.title: 婚内婚外Married
programme.desc: 公益律师宁悦渐渐发现自己的生活其实一直在无微不至的丈夫胡成的控制之下，他隐藏在完美表象下的种种越矩行为也让宁悦看清了自己婚姻的真相在愤怒之余，宁悦终于清醒，尝试从这段维持了五年的美满婚姻中挣脱出来而在找回自我尝试独立的过程中，宁悦遇到了同为律师的秦灿，正直阳光的他在宁悦成长的过程中提供了诸多帮助然而控制欲极强的胡成却不满于宁悦私下的异常举动，夫妻二人关于婚姻的战斗就此打响

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀Glory of Love
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性借由三个女主角来传达自信勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep12

programme.title: Im Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep01
programme.desc: Saito Hojo hates his classmate, Akane Sakuramori. Yet, the two are forced to get married by their grandparents. Thus begins the newlywed life of the two rivals under one roof...

programme.title: Im Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep02

programme.title: Im Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep03

programme.title: Im Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep04
programme.desc: Akane causes a ruckus after finding a ghost? at home. Saito asks Shisei for help as Shisei ends up staying over. Akane starts feeling uneasy over the closeness between Saito and Shisei...

programme.title: Im Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep05
programme.desc: Himari tells Akane that she likes Saito and asks for her support. Himari and Saito get closer as Akane begin to have mixed feelings. Later, Himari visits Akane at home while Saito hides.

programme.title: Im Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep06
programme.desc: Himari suggests a group study session with Saito, Akane and Shisei, while Saito and Akane work hard to keep their secret. Later, Saito notices Akane feeling down and asks her on a date.

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Faye Kusairi, Zain Hamid, Lisdawati dan Santesh.

programme.title: PODCAST LAGENDA
programme.desc: Episod kali ini bersama Afdlin Shauki, figura seni serba boleh yang dikenali sebagai pelakon, pengarah, pelawak, dan penerbit. Beliau berkongsi kisah kerjaya, pelbagai pengiktirafan yang diterima, serta inspirasi buat generasi baharu dalam dunia produksi kreatif.

programme.title: RESEPI MOYANG
programme.desc: Dalam episod ini, hos akan belajar memasak masakan tempatan iaitu Gulai Daging Kedah Lopes Pandan Gula Melaka. Dihos oleh Mek Yun.

programme.title: ROJAK
programme.desc: Episod kali ini menyaksikan Hana Tiha melakukan aktiviti di Digital Sport Arena. Seterusnya, segmen Snacktime membawakan beliau mencuba makanan dan minuman di Hulu. Akhir sekali, segmen Cabaran menguji geng cabaran dalam permainan Food Testing.

programme.title: BAKAR
programme.desc: Bakar adalah sebuah rancangan memasak dengan kaedah bakar yang menggunakan ketuhar. Untuk episod kali ini, Chef Kim akan berkongsi dengan penonton, cara menyediakan Ikan Bakar bersama Sos Lemon, Biskut Coklat Malta Kek Tembikai Laici.

programme.title: TERBAIK DARI JALANAN
programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Untuk episod kali ini, mereka akan pergi ke Kafe Beriyani Gam Putrajaya, Tasti Dough dan Renees Smash Burger.

programme.title: KLTV 2026
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan informasi yang memfokuskan tentang dunia hiburan di Malaysia dari pelancaran music wayang terbaru, isu isu panas terkini dan juga rancangaSiri best untuk dilayan.

programme.title: CELEBS DAY OFF
programme.desc: Saksikan bagaimana seorang selebriti mengisi hari cuti mereka dengan bermacam aktiviti-aktiviti menarik. Dihoskan oleh Asmawi, anda akan mengenali lebih lanjut kisah kehidupan dan karier tetamu undangan kali ini, Natasha Elyzza.

programme.title: HURU HARA

programme.title: DEKO BAJET
programme.desc: Untuk episod ini, pereka bentuk dalaman, Janna Baha selaku pengacara juga akan menghias semula bilik anak milik pasangan Ummar dan Atikah di sebuah kondominium di Bukit Jalil dengan Bajet Rm 3,000.00

programme.title: KEMBARA

programme.title: Rembulan Tenggelam Di Wajahmu
programme.desc: Ray, seorang pemilik konglomerat berusia 60 tahun yang kaya-raya tetapi kesepian, kini sakit tenat dan terlantar di hospital menanti ajal. Semasa berada di ambang maut, seorang lelaki misteri berwajah samar muncul lalu membawanya mengembara secara spiritual ke masa lampau. Sambil mengimbau kembali detik kejayaan serta kedukaan pada zaman mudanya, Ray cuba mencari jawapan kepada lima persoalan besar tentang kehidupan, takdir, dan keadilan yang selama ini sering dipersoalkannya kepada Tuhan.

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Ayam Thai Cucur Manis sambil ditemani oleh ar3s jemputan, Faruq Suhaimi.

programme.title: Oppss Terpikat Cik Sombong
programme.desc: Marlia mengupah penyiasat untuk mencari di mana Hans tinggal. Marlia memaksa Ira balik bersamanya. Pada mulanya Ira turut merasa serba salah kerana dia mula percaya yang Hans dapat menjaga dan merawatnya di rumah itu. Tetapi Marlia terus mendesak sehingga Ira bersetuju untuk pulang ke rumah Marlia semula. Di rumah, Marlia minta Mak Biah mengangkat Ira tetapi Ira mahu Hans yang mengangkatnya naik ke bilik. Sementara itu Siti anak mak Biah telah mula berbaik dengan seorang pelanggan Kamal yang bernama Aiman. Kamal tidak menyukai Aiman dan melarang Siti yang lurus itu dari berkawan dengannya. Siti menganggap larangan Aiman itu sebagai interpretasi kecemburuaan Kamal sendiri. Marlia mula mengawal Ira dan tidak membenarkan Hans membawa Ira ke pusat terapi. Ketika Hans cuba mengajar dan mengusik ketika Ira berjalan, Ira terjatuh.

programme.title: Ana Kleopatrena
programme.desc: Dato Ramdan memberi Taufik dan pasukannya bonus dan cuti bergaji kerana hasil jualan Kleopatrena naik mendadak. Taufik berjaya memujuk Edora menyertai Johan dan Ana apabila tahu yang mereka akan pergi bercuti. Mereka terkandas di tengah perjalanan dan terpaksa menginap di sebuah rumah tumpangan usang dalam hutan.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Wok disiksa suami sendiri, disiksa batin dan fizikal kerana nafsu binatangnya. Maimun semakin teruk dan akhirnya menghembuskan nafas seorang diri di rumah. Sampai ke bandar, usop sedaya upaya menjejaki Wok. Akhirnya usop dapat bertemu dengan Deris. Wok dapat melepaskan diri, apabila Deris telah lalai kelam kabut keluar rumah tanpa mengunci mangga pintu.

programme.title: Misteri Mona

programme.desc: Program Dari Hati Wanita merupakan sebuah sesi perkongsian yang mengetengahkan isu dan cabaran yang dihadapi oleh wanita masa kini melalui panduan dan hikmah yang terkandung dalam al-Quran.

programme.title: Politik Ummah
programme.desc: Amin Idris selaku hos bersama Ustaz Marwan Bukhari sebagai tetamu jemputan mengulas tentang Tahaluf Siyasi yang mengupas konsep kerjasama politik Tahaluf Siyasi dalam sistem demokrasi moden, sejarah keharusannya berdasarkan sirah Nabawiyah, praktikal perikatan politik di Malaysia dan luar negara.

programme.title: Pesan
programme.desc: Mengupas tentang Cinta kepada Allah dan Kepentingan Memakmurkan Masjid yang membincangkan masjid sebagai Rumah Allah Baitullah dan tempat paling mulia oleh Ustaz Nik Omar Nik Abdul Aziz.

programme.title: Hadis 114
programme.desc: Hadis 114 menampilkan Ustaz Muhamad Hafiz Abdul Rahman sebagai penceramah menyampaikan pengajian ilmu asas hadis Sahih Al-Bukhari membincangkan Ghibah yang dibenarkan. Di bawah tema Adab.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. Bertemu Hisham ketika cuba melarikan diri, mereka berdua mula jatuh cinta selepas menghabiskan masa bersama di kampung Hisham. Konflik berlaku apabila penjenayah tersilap menculik orang yang menyebabkan Faridah dan Hisham perlu melakukan sesuatu untuk menyelamatkan Azura.

programme.title: Gemerlapan
programme.desc: Mimi mengejutkan ramai pelajar di sebuah kolej berprestij kerana menjadi seorang penggemar muzik dangdut yang tegar. Nel, salah seorang pelajar di situ menganggap muzik dangdut kekampungan dan mereka berdua sering bertengkar kerana hal tersebut. Tetapi tanpa disedari, Nel adalah Mr X yang selama ini merupakan peminat rahsia Mimi dalam diam.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk Jangan Bernafas. Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai footage menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Suratan Kasih
programme.desc: Sunny mengalami tekanan jiwa selepas melihat ibunya yang sedang berzina mati dibunuh ayahnya sendiri. Apabila meningkat dewasa, Sunny menjadi seorang pembunuh bersiri di sebalik kerjayanya sebagai komposer dan pemuzik. Mangsanya ialah golongan artis yang melakukan perbuatan zina. Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.desc: The tricky CHING CHEUNG KA FAI and the loafer, JIAN, CHIN KA LOK always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIANs teacher, SUN LIU KAI CHI to death. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHINGs talent together with JIAN and LUNs assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as The Virgin Courtesan, The Twins and The Nice Weather etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. Mo-sheung teams up with Tsz-yings secret lover Lee Tak-lung Kenneth Ma and uses a series of accidents that Tsz-ying once experienced to incite mutual hatred among the four women. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Game of Deceit
programme.desc: The tricky CHING CHEUNG KA FAI and the loafer, JIAN, CHIN KA LOK always cheat to earn a living. Unexpectedly, they incur, JIANs teacher, SUN LIU KAI CHI to death. They even make the banker, HUNG LAW LOK LAUs business bankrupted and HUNGs daughter, PO, CHEUNG YUK SHAN has become a courtesan. CHING has disclosed LUN HSUAN JESSICA HESTERs female identity who is the owner of a famous adjusting agent The First Tooth. LUN forces CHING to marry her so as to protect her adjusting agents reputation. To CHING it is a great torture as he has to change from a tricky swindler to an impartial adjuster. CHING has then become the person in-charge of the adjusting agent. With CHINGs talent together with JIAN and LUNs assistance, they manage to clear up many swindling cases such as The Virgin Courtesan, The Twins and The Nice Weather etc. Though CHING and LUN, JIAN and PO are enemies at the beginning, they gradually become lovers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: War Of Thorns
programme.desc: Seven years after movie queen Kwan Tsz-ying Yoyo Chen committed suicide, her buddy Ha Mo-sheung Tavia Yeung somehow obtains Tsz-yings diary and is shocked to learn she had been betrayed and harmed by her nice sisters Lai Yi-wan Rosina Lam, Lam Fung-yee Elaine Yiu, Leung Fei-nga Kelly Fu and Lam On-on Judy Kwong. To uncover the truth and avenge her friends death, Mo-sheung uses the co-production film The Rose as bait to win entertainment company boss Chan Wan-sang Moses Chan over so as to recruit the four women to participate. As the truth about Tsz-yings death due to coercion from influential capitalists gradually emerges, everyones glamorous facade instantly crumbles, exposing the most despicable and darkest side of human nature.

programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life.

programme.title: Hot Door Night

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: The Wolf Pack squad led by Lao Diao, is a foreign-based team that specializes in overseas security jobs. In one of the missions, the squad discovers that a terrorist force is planning to destroy the countrys energy source. Lao Diao is now entrusted with the task of leading his squad to fight back. Can the Wolf Pack save the day?

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journeyher parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: God of Gamblers Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and lives a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jins pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wifes death.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: When a decade-long tunnel project is about to complete, an earthquake strikes and leads to a series of subsidence and landslides. The tunnel and a nearby town are at stake. A retired soldier and his son step up to try and stop the disasters at source. Will the authority decide to blow up the tunnel to save the 160,000 people in town?

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the Gang of Five in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Pass and Goal
programme.desc: After a stock crash wipes out everything she has built, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a grassroots kids football team. Guided by a disabled coach, they prepare to face an elite squad backed by wealthy families. Caught between ambition and conscience, she resolves to use her second half to rewrite the childrens first.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Young and beautiful entrepreneur Joanna is a prime suspect in a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. She pays off a police officer to prove her innocence. During the investigation, they discover another murder case involving Joanna and her lover, and eventually reveals the truth.

programme.title: Love is the only Answer
programme.desc: At Bo and Cheong wedding reception, the projected was initially showing their journey of love, but suddenly a flash of a clip of Cheong and a sexy girl being intimate came up. Bo calmly ran up to the stage and announced that the wedding is cancelled. The incident rapidly became a hot topic on the internet. Within a year, back to being single again, Bo and the living life happily Cheong maintains a good relationship. One day, Cheong decided to play with love and took Bo to participate in a swinging party. The conservative Bo initially wanted to leave, but after being bribed by Cheong, she helpless and stayed. At the swinging party, the two encounter Kit and his wife Man Lai. The 4 of them develop a romantic and hot relationship... At another wedding reception, when the projector plays the groom and brides heartwarming clips, a flash of another clip that does not want to be seen comes up...

programme.title: Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Extended Version
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Evas mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mothers wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Evas heart?

programme.title: Shes Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: A group of bounty hunters, including San, Yo, Cat, Swan and Bobo, are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings that have plagued an international hotel group. Unfortunately, Swan, Cat and Bobo are kidnapped by the mastermind of the bombings. Can San and Yo save them? Will the bounty hunters accomplish their mission?

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer knows his father Wah is intellectually challenged since young and has to take care of him after his mother left them. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter!

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kongs Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai becomes the prime suspect in a police murder case. He takes hostages at the police station and demands to negotiate with former negotiator Jun. As the two engage in a high-stake battle of wits, their expertise in psychological manipulation leads to a tense verbal sparring match, gradually shifting their positions and mind sets.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhens childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the wars front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert historys tragedy.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the groups drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummers mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master Shadow Whip, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to Shadow Whip?

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsmans death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiaos Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clans disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score The Proud One. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clans leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Love without End1961
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: Buddhas Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddhas Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the Flying Guillotine Squad, a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her fathers debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights, is the directorwriters warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wongs caught in the Mongs territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Pings limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: URI: The Surgical Strike
programme.desc: Major Vihaan Singh Shergill of the Indian Army leads a covert operation against a group of militants who attacked a base in Uri, Kashmir, in 2016 and killed many soldiers.

programme.title: Thangaraja
programme.desc: Engal Thanga Raja is about a brother who seeks revenge for the murder of his brother by pretending to be an escaped convict.

programme.title: Yaagavarayanium Naa Kaaka
programme.desc: Saga, a middle-class student, navigates friendship, love, and pressure to succeed while facing consequences after skipping exams. As challenges arise, he fights to keep his relationships intact.

programme.title: Asvins
programme.desc: A bunch of YouTubers accidentally unleash a 1500-year-old evil from the dark realm, causing chaos in the human world. Now, they must band together to stop it!

programme.title: Nota
programme.desc: After a CM is charged with corruption, he is forced to pass the baton to his son. He with no political experience, finds himself stuck to the chair.

programme.title: Thiruttu Payale 2
programme.desc: An honest police officer, under orders from a senior official, records conversations of elite professionals. While on duty, he discovers an online sociopath and decides to reveal his identity.

programme.title: Robinhood
programme.desc: A modern Robin Hood switches from stealing to protecting when circumstances make him the reluctant bodyguard of a high-profile client.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.desc: A king received a blessed coin, the Maragadha Naanayam, granting him power. After his death, the coin causes a string of deaths. A man takes the challenge to retrieve it.

programme.desc: Vicky, an insomniac, tries a dream-enhancing pill, only to find his subconscious fantasies bleeding into reality, blurring the lines between dreams and chaos.

programme.title: Vithaikkaaran
programme.desc: Revolve around smuggling and how protagonist is given the charge to retrieve certain withheld goods.

programme.desc: Sakthi, a pickpocket, and Sathya, a police officer, team up to uncover the person behind a series of deaths and bring them to justice.

programme.desc: A sketch artist and a cop work together to unravel the identity of an elusive killer using the descriptions of his face, etched into the memory of an eye-witness to the brutal crime.

programme.title: Caspers Scare School
programme.desc: Cheese! - Casper asks his uncle Stinky to fix Manthas polaroid camera - theyve got a fear test and she wanted to take photos of frightened things for the test. As they struggle to fix the camera, Casper accidentally takes a picture of his uncle, who inexplicably disappears and finds himself locked inside the picture! What on EARTH is happening? Casper has to make things right - and as soon as possible so Mantha doesnt fail her test. Thatch realizes what the camera is doing, steals it and sets to take a photograph everyone in Scare School, hoping to trap them forever inside the little photographs and stick them in a big book of captured monsters! Casper must save the day before EVERYONE winds up in the spooky photo album evil Thatch is concocting.. Caspers New Friend - Casper accidentally frees Goo The Giggling Ghoul from a vial in the science lab. Goos a super friendly ghost who races off to wreak friendly havoc in Deedstown. Goo was actually the result of one of Professor Burns failed experiments - and was never meant to be let out of the jar! - so Casper must bring him back to School before the Headmasters banish Casper himself from School - not to mention that Goo is a serious menace to the Balance of Fear!

programme.title: Caspers Scare School
programme.desc: Sweet Dreams - Thatch is up to no good. Hes SO desperate to win the grading trophy that hes putting everyone to sleep - even the teachers! - in a sneaky plan to get great grades for himself. Casper works out that Thatch is using a charmed song to put everybody to sleep. Casper is determined to break the spell and Thatch will do everything he can to put Casper and his friends to sleep! 2026未來與希望第15集
programme.desc: 2026未來與希望

programme.title: 生活智多星第1878集
programme.desc: 人間衛視生活智多星邀請到好門媳婦－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上智多星本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解生活智多星內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射充滿元氣的不老傳說以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，生活智多星全面關心

programme.title: 梵音清流第3集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞梵唄就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義

programme.title: 幸福食堂第358集
programme.desc: 由人氣主持人攜手多位蔬食名廚，現場烹調精緻美味的蔬食餐點，讓您大飽眼福，也大飽口福

programme.title: 人間佛學院第98集
programme.desc: 人間佛學院希望能帶領觀眾研習佛學義理，深入經藏智慧的法門，將人間佛教的理念，徹底落實在我們日常生活當中，且聽人間佛教的修行者深入淺出地帶您遨遊浩瀚佛法

programme.title: 歡樂家長群第7集
programme.desc: 編劇劉向上日常時間安排相對自由，在家裡負責兒子果寧女兒果寶的教育陪護，妻子戴靜選擇在薪酬較高的外地公司打拼劉向上一家因為孩子開學而與朋友鄰居及其他學生家長成為群友，面對各種突發狀況的新手家長們和鬼馬精靈的孩子們共同迎接教育新課堂人生新起點的故事

programme.title: 布袋小和尚第9集
programme.desc: 說趣事悟禪理善能量以生動易懂的品德道理為主旨，精采呈現一部老少皆宜有趣感人的禪理動畫作品布袋小和尚是中國大陸首部為孩子原創製作的禪意動畫片布袋小和尚以彌勒佛化身的布袋和尚為原型，以奉化雪竇寺為故事發生地，講述一個逍遙自在無拘無束笑口常開的大肚彌勒小和尚，和他的夥伴小布袋吉祥鳥，被委以修建廟宇的重任在重建廟宇的過程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各種稀奇古怪啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚運用他的聰明才智和神奇布袋，揚善懲惡，幫助百姓克服困難，用愛心溫暖人間劇情輕鬆有趣又感人，將中華傳統美德融入其中，使得教育與娛樂相結合，教導少年兒童做好事說好話存好心等行為道德，在笑中體會道德的光芒

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流人間新聞此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任人間新聞報導的焦點包含慈善公益社會關懷文化藝術人文教育心靈提升健康醫療環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第351集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目藝次元宇宙，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事

programme.title: 桃園忙什麼第1集
programme.desc: 用外景或棚內錄影專訪的方式，介紹桃園市現在正發生的，與民眾有關連的各種議題，受訪的來賓或團體包含各領域的專家，與觀眾一起暢聊桃園大小事

programme.title: 島嶼生機第5集
programme.desc: 節目深耕地方，用鏡頭記錄台灣的環境變遷，細膩描繪土地與居民的故事，展現地方媒體的正向力量與人文關懷

programme.title: 生活快易通第235集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的萬人美老師－郭昱晴擔任主持人以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元

programme.title: 映照人生第506集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大由印尼大愛臺製作的映照人生，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明

programme.desc: 小鷗（奚伊鷗）是蘇家最小的媳婦，不幸在進門前後，公公跟老公就相繼掛掉，使她完全不得夫家人心守寡的小鷗也巴不得不再跟婆家有任何牽連，但天不從人願，命運使她跟婆婆越走越近一天婆婆邀她回去吃中秋飯，她以為婆婆好意，沒想到是要她簽字放棄丈夫的壽險繼承，而由買保險的婆婆受益她氣得要劃清界線，結果意外發現夫家的餅舖珍賀齋即將面臨關門的命運，婆婆要北上依靠三子一女度過晚年小鷗假裝事不關己，卻陸續聽到幾個兒女像詐騙集團一樣訛詐婆婆的養老金，激起她的同情心，想幫婆婆一把落到無家可歸的彩香急需幫助，但援手來自於這不得她疼的媳婦，她又拉不下臉經由烘焙師發貴的巧妙牽引，小鷗跟彩香約定不以婆媳關係，而以事業

programme.desc: 探索產業風情，通過讓KC走出去並進行優等食材大搜查的方式來介紹我們將結合休閒農漁牧產業以及各地的產銷班，展示各種加值特產品在輕鬆活潑的氛圍中，我們將向觀眾介紹農村養殖漁業和畜牧業的各種風情 主持人Claire是客家子弟，而Kevin則來自新加坡他們將從多元的觀點出發，呈現台灣飲食文化的融合，包括閩南客家外省

programme.title: 共享觀點第227集

programme.title: 福氣來了第80集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈太極和律動等項目同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動農特產品表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨

programme.title: 一家之煮第479集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾了解感動人的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第12集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：學嘴學鼻全新推出的幼兒節目學學嘴學學鼻，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字

programme.title: 森林偵探隊大埔腔第21集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉阿新牯卡卡面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫
